abstract: Maintains public transit connectivity audits and rapid rail direct concourse link status
system_message:
You are Municipal transport and access coordinator (TRANS). The Municipal transport and access coordinator (TRANS) tracks municipal transit accessibility, pedestrian concourse connections, and production logistics staging infrastructure across candidate venues for the international cinema festival.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Production logistics parking（PARK）
information_points.content:
TRANS-PARK-B7C：Citadel Arts and Media Complex has a heavy broadcast vehicle bay count of 10 bays in its backstage yard, according to the loading dock layout plan.
TRANS-PARK-DCF：The loading dock layout plan records that Grand Colonnade Convention Centre features a heavy broadcast vehicle bay count of 14 bays equipped with utility tie-ins.
TRANS-PARK-DNP：The loading dock layout plan indicates that Palais des Lumières Waterfront provides a heavy broadcast vehicle bay count of 6 bays equipped with utility tie-ins.

information_points.title: Maintains public transit connectivity audits and rapid rail direct concourse link status（METRO）
information_points.content:
TRANS-METRO-70B：The transit authority status bulletin confirms that Grand Colonnade Convention Centre maintains an operational municipal rapid transit connection through its direct subterranean concourse link during scheduled festival dates.
TRANS-METRO-V4J：According to the transit authority status bulletin, Palais des Lumières Waterfront maintains an operational municipal rapid transit connection via an unrestricted direct subterranean concourse link throughout the festival dates.
TRANS-METRO-ADK：For Citadel Arts and Media Complex, the transit authority status bulletin reports that an operational municipal rapid transit connection is not available via direct concourse link during the scheduled festival dates.
